description:
The outbound transfer arc drawn on /fly for missions with flight.arrival.v_infinity_km_s data does not reflect the mission's actual arrival V-infinity — the arc is always the baseline Hohmann Keplerian ellipse, regardless of transfer energy. The code path that constructs the arc (buildArcs → transferEllipse) has a parameter for arrival V∞ but explicitly discards it.

Expected: When a mission has flight.arrival.v_infinity_km_s data, the outbound arc shape on /fly should differ from the pure Keplerian baseline in a way that reflects the mission's actual transfer energy (higher V∞ → more eccentric/bulging arc; lower V∞ → flatter arc), while keeping both endpoints pinned exactly to the Earth departure and destination arrival positions.

Acceptance criteria:
- For a mission with flight.arrival.v_infinity_km_s present, the outbound arc midpoint (r at ν≈π/2) must differ from the transferEllipse baseline midpoint by more than 0.01 AU [reporter: Q: 'The mid-arc bend is wrong because the arrival V-infinity is not being applied. A high arrival V-infinity should bend the middle of the arc away from the baseline (pure-ellipse) shape.']
- For a mission with flight.arrival.v_infinity_km_s ≈ Hohmann baseline (2.94 km/s for Earth→Mars), the arc midpoint should be close to the baseline (±0.05 AU), matching the existing outboundArc() behavior where ratio ≈ 1 produces ~zero bend [repo-data: src/lib/fly-physics.test.ts L149-156: 'V∞ at Hohmann baseline produces ~zero bend']
- The first arc point must be within 1e-6 AU of the live Earth position at departure day, and the last arc point must be within 1e-6 AU of the live destination position at flyby/arrival day — no endpoint drift [reporter: Q: 'My notes only say both endpoints must stay pinned to the transfer points exactly — any start-point drift would violate that.']
- All points in the arc must be finite (no NaN, no ±∞) for any mission with flight data [code-invariant: self-evident: the app must not crash or produce invisible geometry]
- The trajectory-soundness test 'V∞ shaping (when present) keeps arc finite + bounded' must actually test V∞ shaping (not the unshaped ellipse) once the fix lands [code-invariant: src/lib/trajectory-soundness.test.ts L171-183: the test name claims V∞ coverage but buildMissionArcs uses transferEllipse which ignores V∞]

Domain facts:
- Hohmann baseline arrival V∞ for Earth→Mars ≈ 2.94 km/s (derived from vis-viva: v_transfer_arrival - v_dest_circular at Mars orbit)
- Missions with V∞ above baseline: Mariner 4 (5.0), Mars Pathfinder (6.1), Mars 3 (5.7) — should bulge outward more
- Missions with V∞ below baseline: Curiosity (2.43), Perseverance (2.4) — should be flatter
- The fix must add V∞-awareness to transferEllipse() (or create a new function) that preserves both endpoints, since outboundArc()'s V∞ shaping violates endpoint pinning
